<subject>SWPC 501D5A Generator Damaged Aboard M/V INDUSTRIAL BRIDGE</subject>
<body>
Waiting on response from your team regarding:  
Meeting with adjuster about pursuing SWPC.  
Hiring engineering expert to hopefully challenge underwriter's surveyor's findings.

Have issued letter to ship owner to extend time for initiating legal proceedings (this safeguards the subrogation position of the underwriter).

Seeking written confirmation on policy requirement to initiate "legal action" against underwriter within one year of incident. Broker advises this isn't required as claim is already filed and active, but will obtain formal confirmation from underwriter/adjuster.

Michael Boyer to reach out to Perth attorney representing SWPC underwriter about coordinating with their action against ship owner.

If anyone above has additional input or corrections to the points listed, please advise now so we remain aligned.
</body>
